name: Delinea Secret Server
summary: Delinea Secret Server is a vault for privileged credentials that also records and monitors sessions. Delinea sells the Delinea Platform in Essentials, Standard and Enterprise bundles, and neither the product page nor the bundle page shows a price, so buyers request a quote. The Secret Server page offers a 30-day free trial.

facts.text: The Secret Server page lists an encrypted vault, automated password rotation and expiration, check-in and check-out, role-based access and approval workflows.
The Secret Server page links to a free 30-day trial. The bundle page does not state a trial length.
The Delinea Platform is sold in Essentials, Standard and Enterprise bundles. The bundle page lists a vault and session monitoring in each of them.
Privilege elevation is listed in the Standard and Enterprise bundles. The bundle page has a Zero Standing Privilege section but does not list it as included in any bundle.
